questions.question: What is one way to increase the strength of the magnetic field produced by an electromagnet?
options: Increase the number of turns of wire in the coil
Decrease the number of turns of wire in the coil
Use plastic coated string instead of wire
Cool the wire down to absolute zero

questions.question: How does changing the electric current affect the strength of an electromagnet's magnetic field?
options: Decreasing the current makes the magnetic field stronger
Increasing the current makes the magnetic field stronger
Increasing the current has no effect on the magnetic field
Increasing the current makes the magnetic field weaker

questions.question: If the coils of wire on an electromagnet are wound more closely together, what happens to its magnetic field?
options: It becomes weaker
It remains exactly the same
It becomes stronger
It disappears completely

questions.question: Why will an electromagnet made from bare wire fail to work if the adjacent turns of wire are touching?
options: The bare wire will melt instantly due to electrical friction
The magnetic field lines will cancel out because of the bare metal
The wire will become a permanent magnet and cannot be turned off
The current will short-circuit across the turns instead of flowing around the coil

questions.question: Why does inserting a soft iron core into the coil increase the strength of an electromagnet?
options: The soft iron core becomes magnetised when the current is turned on
The soft iron core conducts heat away from the copper coils
The soft iron core increases the electrical resistance of the wire
The soft iron core prevents the wires from touching each other

questions.question: What is always produced around a wire when an electric current flows through it?
options: An electrostatic charge on the surface
A magnetic field around the wire
A permanent north pole at one end
A vacuum around the wire

questions.question: When an electric current flows through a coil of wire, why is the resulting magnetic field stronger than that of a straight wire?
options: The resistance of the wire decreases when it is bent into a coil shape
The electric current speed increases as it travels in a circle
The magnetic field around each loop adds together to make a stronger field
The coil traps air which concentrates the magnetic force

questions.question: Which of the following describes how a basic electromagnet is constructed?
options: Connecting two permanent magnets together with plastic string
Heating a steel bar until it becomes red hot
Rubbing a piece of copper with a plastic rod
Wrapping a coil of wire around a central core

questions.question: What defines an electromagnet compared to a permanent magnet?
options: It is a magnet that can be turned on and off with an electric current
It does not require any materials to make it
It is always active and never loses its magnetic power
It only attracts non-metal objects

questions.question: Which poles are found on all magnets?
options: A positive pole and a negative pole
A north-seeking pole and a south-seeking pole
An active pole and a passive pole
An eastern pole and a western pole

questions.question: What happens when the north-seeking pole of one magnet is brought close to the north-seeking pole of another magnet?
options: They attract each other
They cancel each other out and lose their magnetism
They repel each other
They rotate to point towards the East

questions.question: How does a magnetic material behave when brought near the poles of a magnet?
options: It is repelled by both poles
It is attracted to the north-seeking pole but repelled by the south-seeking pole
It is attracted to the south-seeking pole but repelled by the north-seeking pole
It is attracted to both the north-seeking and south-seeking poles

questions.question: Which group of metallic elements contains only those that are magnetic?
options: Iron, cobalt and nickel
Iron, copper and zinc
Gold, silver and platinum
Aluminium, nickel and tin

questions.question: Why does the north-seeking pole of a suspended bar magnet point towards the Earth's geographic North Pole?
options: Because the Earth's rotation physically drags the magnet
Because the Earth has its own magnetic field
Because of the gravitational pull of the North Pole
Because the North Pole is colder than the South Pole

questions.question: What behavior does the needle of a plotting compass show when placed near a magnet?
options: It spins continuously in a clockwise direction
It points directly towards the nearest electric socket
It lines up with the magnetic field of the magnet
It points perpendicular to the magnetic field lines

questions.question: In what direction can a magnetic field line be followed around a magnet?
options: From the south-seeking pole to the north-seeking pole
From the center of the magnet outwards to the sides
From the positive terminal to the negative terminal
From the north-seeking pole to the south-seeking pole

questions.question: What do the arrows drawn on magnetic field lines show?
options: The direction of the force on a north-seeking pole of another magnet
The direction of the electric current in the magnet
The direction of the force on a south-seeking pole of another magnet
The direction of gravitational pull near the magnet

questions.question: Which of the following is a true characteristic of the magnetic field around a bar magnet?
options: It is completely asymmetrical
It is symmetrical
It is only present at the north-seeking pole
It forms a spiral shape that never returns to the magnet

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes how magnetic field lines behave?
options: They frequently cross each other at right angles
They start at the poles and end abruptly in the air
They do not cross over each other and are continuous
They only exist inside the metal of the magnet itself

questions.question: How does an electromagnetic door lock use physics to unlock a door?
options: It heats up the keyhole using electric currents to melt a wax seal
It uses static electricity to push the entire door frame away
It permanently magnetizes the brass key so it fits better
It uses an electromagnet to pull a magnetic bolt to unlock the door
